title: Description list
summary: A description list: facts as label and value rows (a site summary, server facts, a record's card with sections, a record's header, a job's parameters, licence details). The labels stand in one column for the whole record and go over their values on a phone; a value can be monospace, figures, a link, copied with a button, a badge, carry a status, a hint and an action; a label a help mark; a section a title and an action; a long value wraps or is cut with the whole of it on demand; an empty one says «Не указан». layout grid is a summary in up to four columns.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

label.description: The list's accessible name, when the page has no heading above it that names it

size.description: The ladder rung: the label and the value are the rung's line and type, the hint and a stacked label the rung below's, a one-line row the rung's control height. 1/2 for a side panel

layout.description: columns: the labels in a column of their own (as wide as the longest label, up to --sf-list-description-label-width), the values beside them; stacked: each label over its value; auto: columns, stacked in a column narrower than 24rem (a phone); grid: the summary under a record's heading -- each label over its value, as many columns as fit at 11rem each and at most columns, every value on one line with an ellipsis and its whole text as title

columns.description: layout grid: at most this many columns (as many as fit at 11rem each)

overflow.description: A value longer than its column: wrap breaks it over lines (anywhere, so a path or a hash wraps too); truncate keeps it on one line with an ellipsis, the full value shown under the pointer (title) and while the value has focus (a press or Tab)

empty-text.description: What an item with no value shows when the item has no empty words of its own; «Не указан» (Not set) when not set

heading-level.description: The level of the section titles in the page's outline

items.description: The facts in order, each {label, value, id?, hint?, mono?, numeric?, copy?, href?, status?, badge?, help?, empty?, action?}, and section items {type: "section", label, id?, action?} that open a section of the record (decision C33). A property, or the JSON island a server prints. value is text (a number is written as it is, in figures of one width); an empty value (no text and no badge) shows empty (the item's words) or empty-text, and then no link, no copy button and no status are drawn. mono writes the value in the monospace face (a path, a hash, a key), numeric in figures of one width (a sum), copy adds a button that copies it (always shown), href makes it a link, status puts a status icon before it (success, warning, error, info; neutral or none draws nothing; none with a badge, the badge is the one mark), badge draws an sf-badge on the value's line ({text, status | scheme, icon?}), hint is a line under it, help puts a help mark (sf-help-mark) after the label, action one ghost button after the value -- an empty value's «Указать» too ({label, event?, href?}; a press asks apply, or navigate with href). A section's label is its title, a heading at heading-level, its action stands at the head's end. Every label of a record with sections shares one column. An item without a label is left out

sf-list-description-navigate.summary: A person pressed a value link or an action link (an action with href) (vocabulary §5 navigate {id, href}). A request: a page cancels it to go there itself (a router); not cancelled, the browser follows href. A press with a modifier key or a middle button opens the link elsewhere and asks nothing

sf-list-description-apply.summary: A person pressed an item's or a section's action button, one without href (vocabulary §5 apply {action, scope: entry, ids}): action is the action's event («edit» when it names none), ids and id the item's or the section's id, kind item or section. The page does it (opens a form, a dialog) and sets the list again

forbidden_client_responsibilities: loading or saving the facts (the host sets the list)

keyboard: Tab reaches, in reading order, each section's action, each help mark, each value link, each copy button, each item's action and, with overflow truncate, each cut value; Enter follows a link, copies or presses the action
accessibility.focus: The list never takes focus itself.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-list-description for read-only facts as label and value: a site summary, server facts, a record's header, a job's parameters, licence details.
do_not: Do not use it to edit values; sf-view-properties does that
Do not put markup in a value; it is text, the link and the copy button are settings
Do not use it for a table of many records; sf-data-view does that
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-list-description><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"items": [{"label": "Адрес", "value": "demo.test", "href": "https://demo.test/"}, {"label": "Корень сайта", "value": "/var/www/demo", "mono": true, "copy": true}, {"label": "Сертификат", "value": "до 12 декабря", "status": "success"}]}</script></sf-list-description>
